steps.title: Your accounts, connected
steps.caption: Zensus reads your bank, QuickBooks and HubSpot, so every forecast starts from real balances and real customers.

steps.title: Your runway and zero-cash date
steps.caption: The chart projects cash month by month and marks the month it would run out: here, November 2028.

steps.title: What moves cash in a month
steps.caption: Click any month to see its days and the money in and out behind them, week by week.

steps.title: The next 13 weeks
steps.caption: A week-by-week cash ledger for the next quarter, with every expected payment and receipt.

steps.title: Ask what-if in plain English
steps.caption: Ask Zensus about a plan, such as hiring two engineers, and it runs it against your live forecast.

steps.title: It asks what it needs
steps.caption: If something is missing, like the salaries, Zensus asks before it models anything.

steps.title: The answer, in numbers
steps.caption: Zensus models the hires and shows what changes: payroll, burn, runway and the new zero-cash date.

steps.title: See the plan on your runway
steps.caption: The scenario sits next to your base forecast, so you can see the year of runway the hires would cost.
